title: Position
intro: Start by choosing where your banner should appear. Desktop and mobile positions are separate. The heading below confirms your selection and the image size.

title: Image
intro: Upload an image or select one from your library. Adjust the crop, then choose Save Image. The saved image appears in the list below.

title: Link
intro: Add the full website URL and a title, then choose Save Order and Metadata. Save Image saves the picture; this second button saves its link, title and rotation order.

title: One banner or two
intro: Open Desktop layout to choose one banner or two side by side. When split, choose a half to edit. Mobile positions stay separate, and changing the layout preserves images and code.

title: Advanced
intro: Open Advanced for technical position details. Site administrators also find ad code here. Image and link setup does not require this section.

title: Where the ads appear
intro: This optional map is below the editor. Open it to explore video, home and channel pages, or select a space directly. It selects the same position as the list at the top.

title: Real page preview
intro: Show a real page of your site with the selected position outlined. It follows the position you choose; use Close preview to hide it. Mobile preview changes the ADs position selection only.

title: View on site
intro: Opens a page of the site with every ad position outlined and scrolls to this one.
